name: Princess Quest: Mahjong Sword
original_name: マージャン・ソード プリンセス・クエスト
source:
Princess Quest: Mahjong Sword is a medieval-themed, story-driven mahjong game. On the continent of Audores, princesses of various countries and other noble ladies compete in the game of mahjong, trying to gain possession of the sacred titular sword. The player takes control of the young warrior Rutia, who must defeat five opponents on her way to glory.

Mahjong matches follow the typical one-on-one scheme, but the results are presented as battles, with animated attacks and hit points depleted. Money gained from winning mahjong games is spent in the shops on items that can be later used before a mahjong match for various bonuses.

Opponents also undress when losing a mahjong game. The computer version has scenes with explicit nudity as well as torture at those points. The PC Engine (TurboGrafx) CD version only displays scantily clad women, removing nudity and torture scenes.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/55465/princess-quest-mahjong-sword/]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
Princess Quest: Mahjong Sword是一款中世纪主题、故事驱动的麻将游戏。奥多雷斯大陆上，各国公主与贵妇们展开麻将比赛，试图夺取名义上的圣剑。玩家控制年轻的战士露蒂亚，她必须击败五个对手才能获得荣耀。

麻将比赛遵循典型的一对一方案，但结果以战斗形式呈现，具有动画攻击和生命值耗尽。赢得麻将比赛获得的钱可以在商店里购买物品，这些物品可以在麻将比赛之前使用以获得各种奖金。

输掉麻将比赛时，对手也会脱衣服。电脑版本中有明显的裸体场景以及酷刑场景。PC Engine (TurboGrafx) CD版本仅显示衣着暴露的女性，删除了裸体和酷刑场景。
